name: Haira
description: Agent skills for the Haira programming language. Provides complete language knowledge — syntax, types, standard library, agentic constructs (providers, tools, agents, workflows), compiler internals, and idiomatic patterns. Includes two skills: /haira for writing .haira code and /haira-compiler for contributing to the compiler.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills**, `haira` (Complete knowledge of the Haira programming language — syntax, semantics, standard library, and idiomatic patterns), `haira-compiler` (Deep knowledge of the Haira compiler internals — lexer, parser, checker, codegen pipeline, runtime library, and AST design).

Installs with `claude plugin install haira@claude-community` from `mrzdevcore/haira`.
